cohort: The study included 201 pregnant women receiving antenatal care at a tertiary referral hospital in northern Kerala, India.
finding: The prevalence of GDM was estimated at 15.9%, and risk factors such as age >25 years, BMI >26 kg/m2, family history of DM, past history of GDM, history of big baby, and modern life-style were associated with higher GDM prevalence.
